voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Since at least the early nineteen-eighties, a Russian shortwave station has broadcast a near-constant buzz, on the same frequency.
A short, flat buzz. Over and over. Day and night.
Every so often, the buzzing stops. A voice reads out words and numbers in Russian. Then the buzzing comes back.
Listeners have recorded it for decades. Most assume it is military. No one has ever officially said what it is for.
